items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: if it’s a swing gig, Benny Goodman sort of music, Basie kind of music

ctx.x: And I wanted to ask him what he liked but, so if there’s a question here, if you’re on a date, especially where it’s one of those dates like meet the group on the bandstand, hi how are you doing, and it comes time for a bass solo, what’s your inclination to do?

Well if it’s appropriate stylistically — I’ll just put it this way — if it’s a swing gig, Benny Goodman sort of music, Basie kind of music, straight ahead 4/4, more than likely the bass player is going to expect you to go to the hi-hat.
